claims.evidence: The witness report identifies the item as a sewing machine but does not mention any visible branding or logos.
Mechanical functionality cannot be determined from still photos.
The witness specifically noted that the drive belt is not shown.

risks.proof: A video clip showing the hand wheel being turned and the needle bar moving up and down.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged bobbin case and shuttle assembly.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the area under the slide plate showing the bobbin housing.
risks.if_unproven: as incomplete and requiring replacement parts

risks.risk: The machine is a generic brand rather than a genuine Singer.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand decal on the arm or the brass serial number plate.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic unbranded manual machine

risks.proof: A photo showing the leather or rubber belt connecting the large drive wheel to the machine head.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in motion (hand wheel and treadle).
Close-up photo of the brand name and serial number plate.
Photo of the bobbin area with the slide plate open.
Photo showing the presence and condition of the drive belt.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the item is a manual treadle sewing machine, allowing for a baseline valuation at its worst-case (generic, non-functional) state.
